reviewNote: NoScroll is pre-release and installs unsigned onto the reader's own phone. What this guide builds blocks Reels and Shorts inside NoScroll; it does not stop the reader opening the real Instagram or YouTube apps, because that needs an Apple entitlement no self-builder can obtain. The guide says so before the first command.

setupSteps.title: Install Git
setupSteps.verifierLabel: Git responds with a version number

setupSteps.title: Install Node LTS
setupSteps.verifierLabel: Node responds with a version number

steps.title: Open Terminal
steps.body: Keep it open beside Iris.
steps.verifierLabel: Terminal is open

steps.title: Check Git and Node
steps.body: Git and the current Node LTS are required.
steps.verifierLabel: Git and Node respond with version numbers

steps.title: Install pnpm
steps.body: The blocking engine is built with pnpm.
steps.verifierLabel: pnpm responds with a version number

expect.prompt: In the shell, has `npm install -g pnpm` finished — a summary line such as "added 1 package" or "changed 1 package", with the prompt back and no error? Answer not done while it is still downloading, or if it stopped on a permissions error such as EACCES.

hints: If npm refused for lack of permission, reinstall Node from nodejs.org rather than re-running this with more privileges.
Finished but still not found? Open a fresh shell window so the new PATH is picked up.

steps.title: Copy NoScroll to this Mac
steps.command:
cd ~
if [ ! -d noscroll/.git ]; then
git clone https://github.com/Blueturboguy07/noscroll.git
fi
steps.verifierLabel: A noscroll folder appears

steps.title: Open the noscroll folder
steps.verifierLabel: Your terminal prompt is inside the noscroll folder

steps.title: Use the reviewed version
steps.verifierLabel: Git reports the reviewed commit

steps.title: Install the engine's dependencies
steps.verifierLabel: The command finishes without an error

steps.title: Check the blocking rules still work
steps.body: 42 tests over saved copies of the sites. Failures mean the rules need a fix.
steps.verifierLabel: All 42 tests pass

expect.prompt: Does the terminal show a finished vitest run reporting 42 tests passed with no failing tests?

hints: If it says the engine has no node_modules, run the install step above again — it must finish without an error first.
A failing test names the rule file to fix; docs/RULES.md in the repo explains the format.

steps.title: Build the engine into both apps
steps.body: Compiles the engine and copies it, with the rule files, into both phone projects.
steps.verifierLabel: It prints "engine + rules synced to both shells"

expect.prompt: Does the terminal show the line "engine + rules synced to both shells" followed by a byte count?

hints: If node is not recognised, the Node install from setup didn't finish — reopen the terminal and check `node --version`.
If it stops on the build line, the engine's dependencies did not install; go back two steps.

steps.title: Install Xcode
steps.body: Large — start it early. Open it once afterwards so it finishes installing.
steps.verifierLabel: Xcode opens without asking to finish setup

steps.title: Open the iPhone project
steps.verifierLabel: Xcode opens with the NoScroll project

steps.title: Sign the app with your Apple ID
steps.body: In Xcode open Signing & Capabilities, tick Automatically manage, pick your Apple ID.
steps.verifierLabel: Signing & Capabilities shows no red errors

point.descriptor: the Signing & Capabilities tab in Xcode's editor

steps.title: Plug your iPhone in
steps.body: Connect by cable, unlock it, tap Trust, then pick it from Xcode's device menu.
steps.verifierLabel: Your iPhone's name appears in the device menu

point.descriptor: the run destination menu in Xcode's toolbar, just right of the play button

steps.title: Build and install it
steps.body: Press play in Xcode. The first build takes a few minutes.
steps.verifierLabel: NoScroll appears on your home screen

point.descriptor: the play button at the top left of Xcode's toolbar

steps.title: Trust the app on your iPhone
steps.body: Settings, General, VPN & Device Management, your Apple ID, then Trust.
steps.verifierLabel: NoScroll opens instead of showing an Untrusted Developer message

steps.title: Check that it works
steps.body: Open NoScroll, continue past setup, tap Instagram, sign in. The Reels icon should be gone.
steps.verifierLabel: There is no Reels icon in the row along the bottom

unsupported.headline: A Windows PC cannot build an iPhone app
unsupported.reason: Apple only allows iPhone apps to be built and signed on macOS using Xcode, which Apple does not release for Windows. This is Apple's restriction, not a missing feature in NoScroll or Iris — no emulator or virtual machine makes it work reliably.
alternatives: Borrow a Mac for about half an hour — the signature it installs lasts 7 days and can be renewed on any Mac.
Use an Android phone instead, which builds fine from Windows.
Install a Reels/Shorts blocking extension in your phone browser and use instagram.com there. It blocks the same surfaces, but you get no home-screen app.
